metadata.title: feat: add PgBouncer connection pooling to Docker Compose
metadata.author: crivetimihai

commits.message:
feat: add PgBouncer connection pooling to Docker Compose

Add PgBouncer as the default connection pooler between MCP Gateway
and PostgreSQL to reduce connection overhead and improve throughput
under high concurrency scenarios.

- Add pgbouncer service with transaction pooling mode (default)
- Configure gateway to connect via PgBouncer by default
- Reduce PostgreSQL max_connections to 500 (PgBouncer handles multiplexing)
- Use smaller DB_POOL_SIZE (10) since PgBouncer manages connections
- Document configuration, monitoring, and how to disable if needed

Closes #1750

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
